reviews.text: A disappointment, charging an absurd price is simply a lack of respect for the customer who never comes back.

A dog that came in well, came out destroyed, to say the least, disgusting, even had the hair removed from around his eyes, causing the skin to come out. All this while charging €65, and I don't know if he uses the brand he advertises.
I don't recommend it at all. I'm posting photos of the grooming. He was a Maltese, now he's a corpse.
The dog still smelled after being washed, the cut was not very good, not to mention the very high price. 〽️

Very bad, even though they charged extra for the detangling treatment, her fur is patchy and she's cut to the skin. I have a pink Maltese, practically waiting for her fur to grow back because I can't let her out for fear of sunburn. I don't recommend it.
How much does it cost to groom a Maltese?
Great professionalism and kindness towards our little big friends! Congratulations to Stefano and his colleague Miriam!

I'm as used to seeing the qualities of a professional in person as I am to seeing them, not relying on bad reviews. This time, I was too good. Stefano is a serious, well-prepared, and very professional professional.
He treated my poodle with care and dedication, bringing him to a fantastic state of thinning his fur. He explained to me how to care for my puppy before I bring him back to him, which is important because our furry friend needs a bath and a trim every 27 days at most. Only then can we achieve results that are worthy of the web. With that in mind, I just want to add that you can trust the professional who lives there because he is very knowledgeable and serious. Thank you, Stefano. See you in July.

I'm extremely satisfied with the grooming I received for my dog ​​at this salon. They are exceptionally skilled at treating all coat types without shaving, keeping her fur soft and well-groomed. The service is excellent, and the staff is super friendly.
Very positive experience, first bath and first grooming for my 5 month old toy poodle. Experienced, welcoming and kind staff.
